command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: generate SSH CA keypair =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
if [ ! -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca ]; then
  sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N '' -C "ssh-host-ca@node1"
fi
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub
ls -l /etc/ssh/ca/

echo "== STEP 2: sign the host's ed25519 host key with the CA =="
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "node1-host-cert" -h -n node1,"$NODE_IP" -V +3650d /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "== STEP 3: verify certificate content =="
ssh-keygen -L -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "== STEP 4: configure sshd to present the certificate =="
sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.bak.$(date +%s)
if ! grep -q '^HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  echo "HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null
fi

sudo -n cp /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub /tmp/ssh_ca.pub

cat /tmp/ssh_ca.pub

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: set up known_hosts entry that trusts the CA, not a pinned host key =="
cat /tmp/ssh_ca.pub > /tmp/ca_pub
printf '@cert-authority node1,%s ' "$NODE_IP" > /tmp/known_hosts_ca
cat /tmp/ca_pub >> /tmp/known_hosts_ca
cat /tmp/known_hosts_ca

echo "== STEP 2: ensure no pinned host key exists for this host =="
rm -f /tmp/no_pin_known_hosts
touch /tmp/no_pin_known_hosts
cat /tmp/known_hosts_ca >> /tmp/no_pin_known_hosts

echo "== STEP 3: create throwaway SSH client key + authorize it for a test connection =="
rm -f /tmp/client_key /tmp/client_key.pub
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /tmp/client_key -N '' -q
mkdir -p /tmp/test_home/.ssh
cp /tmp/client_key.pub /tmp/authorized_test
cat /tmp/authorized_test >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null || (mkdir -p ~/.ssh && cat /tmp/authorized_test >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys)
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

echo "== STEP 4: connect using StrictHostKeyChecking=yes with ONLY the CA trust line (no pinned host key) =="
ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=/tmp/no_pin_known_hosts \
    -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
    -o BatchMode=yes \
    -i /tmp/client_key \
    -p 22 "$USER@$NODE_IP" 'echo CONNECTED_VIA_CA_TRUST; hostname' 2>&1

echo "== STEP 5: cleanup test client key from authorized_keys =="
grep -vF -f /tmp/authorized_test ~/.ssh/authorized_keys > /tmp/ak.new || true
mv /tmp/ak.new ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
